description: Production-ready Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for ASP.NET Core (.NET 10, official C# SDK 2.0): tools, resources and prompts; OAuth for any OIDC identity provider (Entra ID, Google, Auth0, Okta, Keycloak) with consent; MCP Apps UI (React + Tailwind); typed API clients; validation; tests; Docker; docs.
title: Code4mk MCP Server
